entries.f188630f4412f9ea: A business that plans, develops, imports and sells housing equipment and building materials. It sells online via EC to building professionals such as design offices, general contractors and construction companies, and to general consumers who are building owners, under a “One Price” scheme that lets anyone buy on the same terms and at the same price regardless of the buyer's attributes. To compensate for the weakness of EC, which does not allow customers to check actual products, it has opened showrooms at six locations in Tokyo, Osaka, Sendai, Nagoya, Kyoto and Fukuoka, and unmanned showrooms (Smart Showroom®) at two locations in Sapporo and Yokohama, and showroom staff also provide interior design proposals upon request. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥15,119 million. Watanabe Pipe Co., Ltd. is listed as a major customer.
